TABLE 17.2 Expected Normal Findings During Physical Assessment of the Gastrointestinal System (sources: Diaz de Ortiz & Mendez, 2022; 
Gantan & Wiedrich, 2022; Mealie et al., 2022) 
17.1 • Assess and Analyze the Impact of Nutrition on the Gastrointestinal System
343

Organ Assessed 
Expected Findings 
Abdomen: inspection 
• Skin: intact, uniform in color and consistent with race, no ecchymosis or 
jaundice, silver–white striae (stretch marks) may be present (may be 
purple–pink in pregnant client), surgical scars may be present 
Flat, rounded but not distended or scaphoid (sunken); no protrusions or 
evidence of spleen or liver enlargement; no visible vascular patterns (except 
in pregnancy); respirations should cause symmetric movements of the 
abdomen; in very lean client, aortic pulsations may be visible at the epigastric 
area, and peristalsis may also be visible; umbilical stump should be present in 
newborns 
Abdomen: auscultation 
• Bowel sounds present in all quadrants, low pitched and gurgling and 
occurring at a rate of 2–5 per minute, lasting from less than 1 second to 
several seconds each; no bruits or friction rub; no succussion splash
